<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="22" x2="322" y2="27" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="19" x2="327" y2="27" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="16" x2="332" y2="27" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="18" x2="352" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="363" y="16" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="18" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="384" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,67 22,75 30,83" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="75" x2="41" y2="75" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="82" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Dispute Center</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="101" x2="370" y2="101" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="128" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">
    <tspan x="20" dy="0">Review a transaction or track an existing</tspan>
    <tspan x="20" dy="20">dispute. We’re here to help resolve it.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Search -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="164" width="350" height="44" rx="10" fill="#F9FAFA" stroke="#E1E4E8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="184" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="189" x2="52" y2="194" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="64" y="189" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Search by order or merchant</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Summary -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="225" width="350" height="78" rx="10" fill="#D4FCBC" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="20" y="223" width="350" height="78" rx="10" fill="#F3FAF6" stroke="#ADD993" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="262" r="21" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="43" y="254" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="258" x2="56" y2="258" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="262" x2="56" y2="262" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="266" x2="53" y2="266" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="84" y="253" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Open disputes</text>
    <text x="84" y="275" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4B9460">2 cases · $128.40 under review</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Active disputes -->
  <text x="20" y="337" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Active disputes</text>
  <text x="342" y="337" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Manage</text>

  <!-- Card 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="352" width="350" height="93" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="350" width="350" height="93" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="380" r="18" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <text x="48" y="385" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#267347">GF</text>
    <text x="78" y="375" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Green Fork Kitchen</text>
    <text x="78" y="395" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">$86.50 · Order #MF-48291 · Jun 18</text>
    <rect x="78" y="409" width="81" height="20" rx="10" fill="#FEFAEF"/>
    <text x="118" y="423" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#CC9A00">Under review</text>
    <polyline points="345,382 351,388 345,394" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Card 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="457" width="350" height="93" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="455" width="350" height="93" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="485" r="18" fill="#E8F4FF"/>
    <text x="48" y="490" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1470EB">MP</text>
    <text x="78" y="480" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Maya’s Pantry</text>
    <text x="78" y="500" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">$41.90 · Order #MF-48107 · Jun 12</text>
    <rect x="78" y="514" width="89" height="20" rx="10" fill="#F1F6FC"/>
    <text x="122" y="528" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#1470EB">Waiting for reply</text>
    <polyline points="345,487 351,493 345,499" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- History -->
  <text x="20" y="588" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#121212">Recent activity</text>
  <text x="342" y="588" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">See all</text>

  <g>
    <circle cx="36" cy="620" r="7" fill="#40BF76"/>
    <polyline points="32,620 35,623 41,616" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="616" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">
      <tspan x="56" dy="0">Refund approved for Sunrise Bakery</tspan>
      <tspan x="56" dy="18" font-size="11" fill="#999999">Jun 10 · $24.00 returned to your card</tspan>
    </text>
    <line x1="20" y1="650" x2="370" y2="650" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="680" r="7" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="676" x2="36" y2="684" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="680" x2="40" y2="680" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="676" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">
      <tspan x="56" dy="0">Message sent to Green Fork Kitchen</tspan>
      <tspan x="56" dy="18" font-size="11" fill="#999999">Jun 19 · We’ll update you by Jun 22</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>

  <!-- Initiate dispute button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="725" width="350" height="52" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="164" y1="751" x2="178" y2="751" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="171" y1="744" x2="171" y2="758" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="757" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Start a new dispute</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="794" x2="390" y2="794" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="35,814 45,805 55,814 55,824 35,824" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="32,814 45,803 58,814" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="123" cy="812" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="819" x2="136" y2="825" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="194" y="804" width="20" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="198,820 202,820 198,825" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="808" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="294" cy="823" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="807" r="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="352" y="811" width="18" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="45" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0"><tspan>Home</tspan></text>
    <text x="123" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0"><tspan>Orders</tspan></text>
    <text x="204" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5DB329"><tspan>Support</tspan></text>
    <text x="294" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0"><tspan>Profile</tspan></text>
    <text x="361" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0"><tspan>More</tspan></text>
  </g>
</svg>
